question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Play with fire

options.text: To waste time on worthless things

solution:
The correct answer is '**To do something risky**'.

***__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom '**Play with fire**' is '**To do something ricky**'.
 
• **Play with fire: **take foolish risks. (मूर्खतापूर्ण जोखिम उठाएं)
 
 
• *Example: an urge to** play with fire **made her provoke him...*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** To do something risky.*
